value: **Direct Callouts & Context**: "These findings extend the previous macro-level analyses of power dynamics and suggest that a balance between scaffolding and autonomy is critical to allow youth to exercise authority." | "Balancing scaffolding and autonomy to foster youth authority Our findings also reveal that co-design can foster youth authority through both scaffolding that helps them realize and negotiate their authority, and autonomously, in unstructured settings." | "The ultimate goal of scaffolding, however, is not to create compliance, but to build a foundation of trust and skill from which youth feel empowered enough to meaningfully exercise their authority (Kirshner, 2008)."
